items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was always going to talk to Weeks Hall some more because he acted like he knew Bunk very well. Yeah. He did.

ctx.x: Well, that's what, yeah, that's what I told him and his Uncle Henry used to work little jobs like that. And Bird Guard Adams as well. And this was, I think it was just four of them. I can't remember, the other one's name was Minor. I don't know, I forgot his name. But he died. But he was playing banjo. And they used to work little jobs like that on Saturday night at a, let me see what this was, a place of man was. They used to work there every Saturday night, this man named, I forgot his name. He had a place of…

I was always going to talk to Weeks Hall some more because he acted like he knew Bunk very well. Yeah. He did. I guess he did. But like, somebody told me they used to put on parties there at his house and he'd have
a band here and just Bunk together. He used to have them come up there and play. Because he used to have big parties at that time.
